settings.eyebrow: In stock · leaves the same day
settings.promise: Arrived cracked? Send us a photo on WhatsApp within 48 hours and we print you a new one, free.

settings.question: When will it arrive?
settings.answer: It leaves the day you order and arrives in 2 to 4 days anywhere in Lebanon.

settings.question: How do I pay?
settings.answer: In cash to the courier when your order arrives. Delivery is $5, free from $35.

settings.question: Something arrived damaged?
settings.answer: Send us a photo on WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery and we print you a new one, free. No need to send the broken piece back.

settings.question: Indoors or outdoors?
settings.answer: Indoors, or outdoors in the shade. The matte PLA can soften in strong summer sun or a hot car, so keep it off sunny balcony ledges in July and August.

settings.question: Are these photos?
settings.answer: Not yet. The images are 3D renders of the final designs. We will replace them with photos of the first prints as soon as they come off the printer.
